general.notes: Signaling rate shown as 53.125 ± 100 ppm GBd/Gbd across sections. Pre-FEC BER stated as 2.4e-4 per IEEE P802.3bs. Average launch power min (-2 dBm) and average receive power min (-5.9 dBm) are informative per optical table notes. Receiver sensitivity (OMAouter) -4.4 dBm max defined for transmitter SECQ 0.9 dB; stressed receiver sensitivity -1.9 dBm measured per 124.8.9 at BER in 124.1.1. Stressed sensitivity test uses SECQ 3.4 dB and OMAouter of each aggressor lane 4.2 dBm (test conditions, not receiver characteristics). Link distance 500 m; datasheet notes 2 km version available as separate product. Absolute max case operating temperature lists L-temp as tbd. Supply current Icc typ/max tbd. Regulatory contact Coherent Corp.; product branded Finisar.

general.suggestions: Consider mapping OMAouter launch/receive ranges (-0.8 to 4.2 dBm TX, receive OMAouter to 4.2 dBm) if OMA is in scope. TDECQ 3.4 dB and SECQ 3.4 dB appear but have no schema fields. Damage threshold 5 dBm per lane could map to a dedicated field distinct from rx_overload.
